axiora.ai.provider.description: Model provider: local Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server (LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, OpenRouter, OpenAI...).

axiora.ai.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the provider. Ollama: http://127.0.0.1:11434. OpenAI-compatible: e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1

axiora.inlineCompletion.enabled.description: Show local ghost-text completions while typing (no Copilot account needed).

axiora.inlineCompletion.model.description: Fill-in-the-middle model used for inline completion.

axiora.checkpoints.autoOnSave.description: Automatically create a checkpoint (at most every 5 minutes) when files are saved.

axiora.sync.endpoint.description: Your own settings-sync server URL (e.g. https://updates.axiora.dev/api/sync). Empty disables sync.

axiora.sync.auto.description: Upload settings automatically when settings.json or keybindings.json change.

axiora.context.repoMap.description: Include a compact repository map (files + top-level symbols) in @axiora prompts. Files matching .axioraignore are excluded.

axiora.editor.typewriterMode.description: Typewriter mode: keep the cursor line vertically centered while typing.

axiora.editorconfig.enabled.description: Apply .editorconfig settings (indentation, line endings, trailing whitespace, final newline) without an extension.

axiora.ai.costPer1kInputTokens.description: Price per 1K input tokens for cost estimates (0 for local models).

axiora.ai.costPer1kOutputTokens.description: Price per 1K output tokens for cost estimates.

axiora.lintFix.onSave.description: After saving, automatically let the AI fix remaining errors in the file (repeats until clean).

axiora.lintFix.maxIterations.description: Maximum fix/re-check passes for the AI lint-fix loop.

axiora.keymap.description: Built-in keymap: Vim modal editing or Emacs key bindings.

axiora.mcpServer.enabled.description: Expose this editor as an MCP server on 127.0.0.1 (tools: open editors, selection, read file, diagnostics, find files, open file, write file).

axiora.mcpServer.port.description: Port for the editor MCP server.

axiora.mcpServer.allowWrites.description: Allow MCP clients to write files through the editor.

axiora.latex.buildOnSave.description: Rebuild the PDF on save while its preview is open.

axiora.share.endpoint.description: Your share server: POST {title, markdown, html} -> {url}.

axiora.security.scanOnSave.description: Scan files for secrets and insecure code on open/save (results in Problems).

axiora.arena.models.description: Models to pit against each other in /arena (default: all available).

axiora.dotfiles.repository.description: Dotfiles repository (URL, owner/repo or local path).

axiora.dotfiles.installCommand.description: Install command (default: install.sh/bootstrap.sh/setup.sh, else symlink dotfiles into $HOME).

axiora.agent.keepAwake.description: Prevent system sleep while @axiora or tasks are running.

axiora.ai.router.enabled.description: Adaptive model router: pick small vs large model per request.

axiora.ai.router.largeModel.description: Model for long/complex requests (refactor, debug, design, code blocks).

axiora.ai.router.threshold.description: Prompt size (chars) above which the large model is used.

axiora.docs.maxPages.description: Max pages crawled per documentation source.

axiora.context.liveActions.description: Include what you are doing (active file, recent edits, terminal commands, errors) in @axiora prompts.

axiora.context.fastContext.description: Retrieve the most relevant code for each prompt by keyword search.

axiora.context.extraRepos.description: Extra repository folders whose file lists are included in @axiora context.

axiora.nextEdit.enabled.description: Suggest the same change at the next occurrence after you rename a word (Tab to apply).

axiora.agents.concurrency.description: How many subagents /parallel runs at once.

axiora.github.repo.description: GitHub repository owner/name (default: from the origin remote).

axiora.chat.maxContextTokens.description: When a chat exceeds this many (estimated) tokens, older turns are summarized automatically.

axiora.ai.visionModel.description: Model with image input used for screenshot-to-UI (e.g. llava, qwen2.5vl). Empty = chat model.

axiora.policy.url.description: Optional org context policy JSON ({exclude, redact}) served from your own server; merged with .axiora/policy.json.

axiora.solo.testCommand.description: Verification command for /solo (default: npm test when package.json has a test script).

axiora.runner.machines.description: Self-hosted Axiora runners (bin/axiora-runner.mjs on your own machines). Tokens are stored in secret storage.

axiora.embed.baseUrl.description: Public base URL where you host .axiora/embeds (e.g. your own server); used in the copied iframe snippet.

axiora.inspections.enabled.description: Axiora inspections with quick fixes for JS/TS/Python.

axiora.ai.embeddingModel.description: Embedding model on your model server for the semantic index (falls back to local hashed vectors).

axiora.wasi.replace.description: WASI plugin output replaces the document/selection (otherwise opens in a new tab).

axiora.lsp.autoInstall.description: When a file needs a language server Axiora can manage (Python, Bash, YAML, Dockerfile, Go, Rust, C/C++, Lua): ask, install automatically, or never.

axiora.lsp.disabled.description: Language server ids that are never auto-started (pyright, bash, yaml, docker, gopls, rust-analyzer, clangd, lua).

axiora.lsp.initializationOptions.description: Per-server initializationOptions, keyed by server id.

axiora.dotfiles.installOnStartup.description: Pull and apply your dotfiles when the editor starts.

axiora.dotfiles.ignore.description: Dotfiles that are never linked into your home folder.

axiora.voice.endpoint.description: Local speech-to-text endpoint: whisper.cpp server (/inference) or any OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions.

axiora.voice.model.description: Model name sent to the transcription endpoint.

axiora.container.engine.description: Container engine used by container debugging and runner isolation.
